label: RPG Maker MZ (JavaScript plugins)
summary: RPG Maker MZ: your rules in an engine-free plugin tested with Node, MZ glue in a second plugin, headless Chromium smoke. Bring your own MZ (adopt-first: dev.py setup --from)
setup_step: Make a new project in RPG Maker MZ (anywhere), then: python tools/dev.py setup --from <that project folder>   # copies MZ's files into game/ and registers the game's plugins

adopt_hints.package.json: merge the devDependencies (playwright) and the test script from package.json.gold into yours, then run python tools/dev.py setup. If this package.json is the MZ project's own (NW.js window settings), move the MZ project into game/ first: docs/ENGINE_FLOW.md > Adopting an existing project.
